To: jonas_weber@redwood.com, diego_fernandez@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 18 Nov 2025 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Quick eval request — Hosted API (self-signup)

Hi Jonas / Diego,

I just spun up a Hosted API trial and ran a couple of quick calls. We're interested in a short demo to validate latency/cost with our ingestion pattern (short queries + frequent small batches). Would prefer a 20–30 min session focused on:
- basic request/response latency numbers
- batching and KV cache recommendations for our usage
- quick sandbox provisioning so engineers can try their pipeline during the call

Our CTs are full-stack engs — Sam (me) and Priya (data eng). Can you propose times today or tomorrow?

Thanks,
Sam
Sam Patel
Senior Platform Engineer | Avery Labs

Hi Sam — welcome and thanks for signing up.

We can absolutely run a focused 20–30 minute session. Two options that usually work well:
1) 20-min Quickwalk: short architecture + live sandbox run (recommended if you just want the surface metrics)
2) 30-min Split: 20-min product walk + 10-min ops handoff where we provision sandbox creds and show batching KVs in your flow

Diego (SDR) — can you propose 3 windows for the next 48 hours? Grace from CS is cc'd to prep sandbox access once we lock a slot.

Sam — quick Q: are you expecting any PII in the test payloads during the sandbox? If yes, we'll enable the masked-logs mode for the session.

Best,
Jonas Weber
Director, PLG Operations
Redwood Inference
